title.en: The Second Conditional (If I won, I would buy)
title.es: El segundo condicional (If I won, I would buy)

text.en: The second conditional is about an imagined, unlikely or unreal situation in the present or future: If + past simple, would + base verb. “If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.” The past simple here does not mean past time, it means the situation is imagined. It matches the Spanish “si ganara la lotería, compraría una casa” (imperfecto de subjuntivo + condicional).
text.es: El segundo condicional trata de una situación imaginada, poco probable o irreal en el presente o el futuro: If + pasado simple, would + verbo base. «If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.» El pasado simple aquí no indica tiempo pasado, indica que la situación es imaginada. Equivale al «si ganara la lotería, compraría una casa» (imperfecto de subjuntivo + condicional).

rows: el verbo be después de if

text.en: If + past simple (the condition), would + base verb (the result). Negative: wouldn’t. Short form: I’d buy.
text.es: If + pasado simple (la condición), would + verbo base (el resultado). Negación: wouldn’t. Forma corta: I’d buy.

text.en: The verb be in the if part is were for every person: “If I were you…” In casual speech you also hear was with I / he / she, but were is the safe form.
text.es: El verbo be en la parte con if es were para todas las personas: «If I were you…» En el habla informal también se oye was con I / he / she, pero were es la forma segura.

text.en: First or second conditional? If the situation is real and possible: If I win, I will… If it is imagined or unlikely: If I won, I would…

text.en: The most common mistake: putting would in the if part. The Spanish “si tuviera” corresponds to the past simple: “If I had money”, not “If I would have money”. Would goes only in the result part.
text.es: El error más común: poner would en la parte con if. El «si tuviera» del español corresponde al pasado simple: «If I had money», no «If I would have money». Would va solo en la parte del resultado.

text.en: The past simple here does not mean past time: “If I had a car” means I don’t have a car now. The time is present or future, the past form is the sign that it is imagined.
text.es: El pasado simple aquí no indica tiempo pasado: «If I had a car» significa que ahora no tengo carro. El tiempo es presente o futuro, la forma de pasado es la señal de que es imaginado.

text.en: In a question would goes to the start of the clause: “What would you do if you saw a ghost?” Short answers: “I would.” / “I wouldn’t.”
text.es: En una pregunta would va al principio de la cláusula: «What would you do if you saw a ghost?» Respuestas cortas: «I would.» / «I wouldn’t.»

speak.en: The second conditional is about an imagined or unlikely situation: «if» plus the past simple, then «would» plus the base verb. «If I won the lottery, I would buy a house». The past simple here does not mean past time, it means the situation is imagined. Careful: «would» does not go in the part after «if». Not «If I would have money», but «If I had money». The verb «be» after «if» is «were» for every person: «If I were you, I would talk to him». We also give advice this way: «If I were you, I would see a doctor».
speak.es: El segundo condicional trata de una situación imaginada o poco probable: «if» más pasado simple, luego «would» más verbo base. «If I won the lottery, I would buy a house». El pasado simple aquí no indica tiempo pasado, indica que la situación es imaginada. Cuidado: «would» no va en la parte después de «if». No «If I would have money», sino «If I had money». El verbo «be» después de «if» es «were» para todas las personas: «If I were you, I would talk to him». También damos consejos así: «If I were you, I would see a doctor».

items.sentence: If I won the lottery, I ___ buy a house.

why.en: An imagined situation (winning the lottery is unlikely), so the result is would + base verb: I would buy.
why.es: Una situación imaginada (ganar la lotería es poco probable), por eso el resultado es would + verbo base: I would buy.

will.en: Will is for a real, possible situation (the first conditional); “if I won” signals an imagined situation.
will.es: Will es para una situación real y posible (primer condicional); «if I won» señala una situación imaginada.

did.en: Did is a past helper verb; the result is about the present or future, so you need would.
did.es: Did es un auxiliar de pasado; el resultado es sobre el presente o el futuro, por eso hace falta would.

examples: If I had time, I would help.
She would call if she knew.

tr.en: If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.
tr.es: Si ganara la lotería, compraría una casa.

items.sentence: If I ___ more money, I would travel more.

why.en: The part after if is in the past simple: If I had more money.
why.es: La parte después de if va en pasado simple: If I had more money.

have.en: The simple present (have) is for a real possibility (the first conditional); an imagined situation needs the past simple.
have.es: El presente simple (have) es para una posibilidad real (primer condicional); una situación imaginada necesita el pasado simple.

would have.en: Would does not go in the part after if; the Spanish “si tuviera” is the past simple (had) in English.
would have.es: Would no va en la parte después de if; el «si tuviera» español es el pasado simple (had) en inglés.

examples: If I had a car, I would go.
If we had time, we would go.

tr.en: If I had more money, I would travel more.
tr.es: Si tuviera más dinero, viajaría más.

items.sentence: If she ___ here, she would help us.

why.en: In an imagined situation the form of be after if is were: If she were here.
why.es: En una situación imaginada la forma de be después de if es were: If she were here.

is.en: “Is” is the simple present, for a real situation; an imagined situation needs were.
is.es: «Is» es el presente simple, para una situación real; una situación imaginada necesita were.

would be.en: Would be does not go in the part after if; there the past simple form (were) is used.
would be.es: Would be no va en la parte después de if; ahí se usa la forma del pasado simple (were).

examples: If he were here, he would know.
If it were easy, I would do it.

tr.en: If she were here, she would help us.
tr.es: Si ella estuviera aquí, nos ayudaría.

items.sentence: If I ___ you, I would talk to him.

why.en: The classic form of advice: If I were you, I would… (be is were here).
why.es: La forma clásica del consejo: If I were you, I would… (be es were aquí).

am.en: “Am” would signal a real situation; “if I were you” is imagined, so you need were.
am.es: «Am» señalaría una situación real; «si yo fuera tú» es imaginado, por eso hace falta were.

will be.en: After if there is no will, and “will be” does not signal an imagined situation either; you need were.
will be.es: Después de if no va will, y «will be» tampoco señala una situación imaginada; hace falta were.

examples: If I were rich, I would travel.
If I were him, I would call her.

tr.en: If I were you, I would talk to him.
tr.es: Si yo fuera tú, hablaría con él.

items.sentence: What would you do if you ___ a lot of money?

why.en: An imagined situation after if: the past simple, if you won.
why.es: Una situación imaginada después de if: pasado simple, if you won.

win.en: The simple present (win) is for a real possibility; “would you do” signals an imagined situation, so you need won.
win.es: El presente simple (win) es para una posibilidad real; «would you do» señala una situación imaginada, por eso hace falta won.

would win.en: Would does not go in the part after if; there the past simple is used (won).
would win.es: Would no va en la parte después de if; ahí se usa el pasado simple (won).

examples: What would you do if you were rich?
What would she say if she knew?

tr.en: What would you do if you won a lot of money?
tr.es: ¿Qué harías si ganaras mucho dinero?

items.sentence: I would travel more if I ___ rich.

why.en: An imagined situation: if I were rich.
why.es: Una situación imaginada: if I were rich.

am.en: “Am” would signal a real situation; being rich is imagined here, so you need were.
am.es: «Am» señalaría una situación real; ser rico es imaginado aquí, por eso hace falta were.

would be.en: Would be does not go in the part after if; there it is were.
would be.es: Would be no va en la parte después de if; ahí va were.

examples: I would help if I were there.
She would go if she were free.

tr.en: I would travel more if I were rich.
tr.es: Viajaría más si fuera rico.

items.sentence: If it ___ so cold, we would go to the beach.

why.en: An imagined situation in the negative: if it weren’t so cold.
why.es: Una situación imaginada en negativo: if it weren’t so cold.

isn't.en: “Isn’t” would signal a real situation; would go asks for an imagined situation, so you need weren’t.
isn't.es: «Isn’t» señalaría una situación real; would go pide una situación imaginada, por eso hace falta weren’t.

won't be.en: After if there is no will; an imagined situation needs weren’t.
won't be.es: Después de if no va will; una situación imaginada necesita weren’t.

examples: If it weren't raining, we would walk.
If I weren't tired, I would come.

tr.en: If it weren't so cold, we would go to the beach.
tr.es: Si no hiciera tanto frío, iríamos a la playa.

items.sentence: He ___ happy if he got the job.

why.en: An imagined situation (got), so the result is would be: he would be happy.
why.es: Una situación imaginada (got), por eso el resultado es would be: he would be happy.

will be.en: Will be is for a real possibility; “if he got” is imagined, so would be.
will be.es: Will be es para una posibilidad real; «if he got» es imaginado, por eso would be.

is.en: “Is” is the simple present; the sentence expects a conditional result (would be).
is.es: «Is» es el presente simple; la oración espera un resultado condicional (would be).

examples: She would be glad if you came.
I would be sad if you left.

tr.en: He would be happy if he got the job.
tr.es: Él estaría feliz si consiguiera el trabajo.

items.sentence: If I knew the answer, I ___ tell you.

why.en: An imagined situation (I don’t know the answer), the result is would + base verb: I would tell you.
why.es: Una situación imaginada (no sé la respuesta), el resultado es would + verbo base: I would tell you.

will.en: Will is for a real possibility; “if I knew” shows that I don’t know, so you need would.
will.es: Will es para una posibilidad real; «if I knew» muestra que no lo sé, por eso hace falta would.

did.en: Did is a past helper verb; the result asks for the would + base verb form.
did.es: Did es un auxiliar de pasado; el resultado pide la forma would + verbo base.

examples: If I had time, I would help you.
She would come if she could.

tr.en: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
tr.es: Si supiera la respuesta, te la diría.

items.sentence: We ___ buy a bigger car if we had more money.

why.en: An imagined situation (had), the result is would + base verb: we would buy.
why.es: Una situación imaginada (had), el resultado es would + verbo base: we would buy.

will.en: Will is for a real possibility; “had more money” is imagined, so would.
will.es: Will es para una posibilidad real; «had more money» es imaginado, por eso would.

had.en: “Had buy” is wrong; the result is would + base verb, had belongs in the part after if.
had.es: «Had buy» es incorrecto; el resultado es would + verbo base, had pertenece a la parte después de if.

examples: We would move if we could.
They would help if they knew.

tr.en: We would buy a bigger car if we had more money.
tr.es: Compraríamos un carro más grande si tuviéramos más dinero.

items.sentence: If I ___ a car, I would be on time.

why.en: The Spanish “si tuviera” is the past simple in English: If I had a car.
why.es: El «si tuviera» español es el pasado simple en inglés: If I had a car.

would have.en: Would does not go in the part after if; “If I would have” is a common mistake.
would have.es: Would no va en la parte después de if; «If I would have» es un error común.

have.en: “Have” is the simple present, for a real situation; an imagined situation needs had.
have.es: «Have» es el presente simple, para una situación real; una situación imaginada necesita had.

examples: If I had a dog, I would walk it.
If she had a bike, she would ride.

tr.en: If I had a car, I would be on time.
tr.es: Si tuviera carro, llegaría a tiempo.

items.sentence: If you studied more, you ___ pass the exam.

why.en: An imagined situation (studied), the result is would + base verb: you would pass.
why.es: Una situación imaginada (studied), el resultado es would + verbo base: you would pass.

will.en: Will is for a real possibility (If you study, you will pass); “if you studied” is an imagined situation.
will.es: Will es para una posibilidad real (If you study, you will pass); «if you studied» es una situación imaginada.

did.en: Did would be followed by the base verb, but here the result asks for would + base verb.
did.es: Después de did iría el verbo base, pero aquí el resultado pide would + verbo base.

examples: If you studied, you would learn.
If she asked, he would say yes.

tr.en: If you studied more, you would pass the exam.
tr.es: Si estudiaras más, pasarías el examen.

items.sentence: She wouldn't be late if she ___ at six.

why.en: The imagined condition after if is the past simple: if she left at six.
why.es: La condición imaginada después de if es el pasado simple: if she left at six.

leave.en: The simple present (leave) is for a real possibility; wouldn’t be asks for an imagined situation, so you need left.
leave.es: El presente simple (leave) es para una posibilidad real; wouldn’t be pide una situación imaginada, por eso hace falta left.

would leave.en: Would does not go in the part after if; there the past simple is used (left).
would leave.es: Would no va en la parte después de if; ahí se usa el pasado simple (left).

examples: She wouldn't worry if she knew.
He wouldn't go if he were sick.

tr.en: She wouldn't be late if she left at six.
tr.es: Ella no llegaría tarde si saliera a las seis.

items.sentence: If we had a map, we ___ find the place.

why.en: An imagined situation (we have no map), the result is would + base verb: we would find.
why.es: Una situación imaginada (no tenemos mapa), el resultado es would + verbo base: we would find.

will.en: Will is for a real possibility; “if we had” shows that we have no map now.
will.es: Will es para una posibilidad real; «if we had» muestra que ahora no tenemos mapa.

can.en: Can would mean a present ability; the imagined result needs would.
can.es: Can significaría una capacidad presente; el resultado imaginado necesita would.

examples: If we had a car, we would go.
If I had a key, I would open it.

tr.en: If we had a map, we would find the place.
tr.es: Si tuviéramos un mapa, encontraríamos el lugar.

items.sentence: ___ you be happy if you lived in Mexico City?

why.en: A question in the second conditional: Would you be happy…?
why.es: Una pregunta en el segundo condicional: Would you be happy…?

Do.en: Do is followed by the base verb, but “be” does not take Do; in an imagined situation it is Would you be…?
Do.es: Después de Do va el verbo base, pero «be» no lleva Do; en una situación imaginada es Would you be…?

Will.en: “Will you be…” is a real future question; “if you lived” signals an imagined situation, so Would.
Will.es: «Will you be…» es una pregunta real sobre el futuro; «if you lived» señala una situación imaginada, por eso Would.

examples: Would you go if I asked?
Would she stay if you called?

tr.en: Would you be happy if you lived in Mexico City?
tr.es: ¿Estarías feliz si vivieras en la Ciudad de México?

items.sentence: If I were you, I ___ see a doctor.

why.en: In advice the result is would + base verb: I would see a doctor.
why.es: En un consejo el resultado es would + verbo base: I would see a doctor.

will.en: Will is for a real possibility; “if I were you” is an imagined situation, so would.
will.es: Will es para una posibilidad real; «if I were you» es una situación imaginada, por eso would.

did.en: Did is a past helper verb; the advice asks for the would + base verb form.
did.es: Did es un auxiliar de pasado; el consejo pide la forma would + verbo base.

examples: If I were you, I would wait.
If I were you, I would call her.

tr.en: If I were you, I would see a doctor.
tr.es: Si yo fuera tú, iría al médico.

items.sentence: If I were free today, I ___ stay in bed.

why.en: An imagined situation (I am not free today), the result is would + base verb: I would stay.
why.es: Una situación imaginada (hoy no estoy libre), el resultado es would + verbo base: I would stay.

will.en: Will is for a real possibility; “if I were” signals an imagined situation.
will.es: Will es para una posibilidad real; «if I were» señala una situación imaginada.

did.en: Did is a past helper verb; the result asks for the would + base verb form.
did.es: Did es un auxiliar de pasado; el resultado pide la forma would + verbo base.

examples: If I were rich, I would travel.
If I could, I would go.

tr.en: If I were free today, I would stay in bed.

wrong.es: «Won» aquí no indica el pasado: would buy muestra que el premio es imaginado y no ha ocurrido.
